The candidate condemns `Current()` parsing and requires deterministic schema-selected parsing plus persisted rules/version identity.
The candidate condemns random UUID adjustment identities on retries and requires deterministic identity with durable uniqueness.
The candidate condemns `float64`, tolerance, and incorrect unsigned rail amounts, requiring exact scaled arithmetic and canonical signed normalization; it does not endorse cross-currency netting.
verdict.summary: The candidate identifies most major failure modes, but several required invariants are only partially specified: immutable evidence storage, versioning with normalized items, exact component assignment and group equations, explicit control-total semantics, out-of-order handling, and durable matched/exception disposition.
